Kitchen & Bathroom Remodeling in Sugar Hill, GA

Sugar Hill is a fast-growing Gwinnett County city nestled between Buford and Gainesville — known for its family-friendly neighborhoods, proximity to Lake Lanier, and a strong community identity that homeowners take pride in. Buford Renovations serves Sugar Hill homeowners with expert kitchen and bathroom remodeling that reflects that same community pride.

Whether you live near Buford Dam Road, Level Creek Road, or along Peachtree Industrial Boulevard, our team delivers kitchen and bathroom renovations that add lasting comfort and value to your Sugar Hill home.

Kitchen Remodeling in Sugar Hill

Our Sugar Hill kitchen remodels focus on creating spaces that work harder and look better. We install custom and semi-custom cabinetry, quartz and granite countertops, subway and mosaic tile backsplashes, and updated lighting. Whether your Sugar Hill kitchen needs a cosmetic refresh or a complete structural transformation, we have the expertise to deliver it.

Bathroom Remodeling in Sugar Hill

We remodel bathrooms throughout Sugar Hill with quality materials and skilled craftsmanship. From master bathroom overhauls to hall bath updates, our work includes tile showers, new vanities, updated plumbing fixtures, and modern lighting. We handle all permitting and inspections so your project is fully compliant.

The primary bathroom is the single most requested project we get in Sugar Hill. Many homes here were finished with a builder-standard master bath — a large garden tub, a small shower, and cultured-marble counters — and owners are ready to turn it into a space they actually enjoy: a spacious tiled walk-in shower, a double vanity with real storage, and finishes chosen for their home rather than a builder’s catalogue. For typical budgets and more detail, see our dedicated Sugar Hill bathroom remodeling page and our 2026 bathroom remodel cost guide.

Outdoor Living: Decks, Covered Patios & Sunrooms in Sugar Hill

Not every Sugar Hill project happens indoors. Many homeowners ask us to upgrade a basic builder deck into a larger patio deck, add a covered patio or covered deck for shade and rain, or enclose the space as a sunroom for year-round use. We design and build all three with the same crew and the same written estimate and schedule as our kitchen and bath work. See our deck and outdoor living services →

We Know Sugar Hill’s Homes

Buford Renovations has been working in Sugar Hill and across Gwinnett County for more than 20 years — our Buford shop is only a few minutes down Buford Highway. The homes that most often come to us for a renovation are 5 to 10 years old — well built, but finished with the builder-standard cabinets, counters, and tile that owners are ready to make their own. Kitchens and primary bathrooms lead the list, followed by outdoor living upgrades: patio decks, covered decks, and sunrooms.

Sugar Hill Remodeling FAQs
How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Sugar Hill?

Every project gets a fixed written estimate after a free in-home consultation — the shower, tile, and any plumbing changes drive cost more than square footage. For typical ranges in our service area, see our 2026 bathroom remodel cost guide, or call (404) 376-5391.

Do you build decks, covered patios, and sunrooms in Sugar Hill?

Yes. Upgrading a basic deck into a larger patio deck, adding a covered patio or covered deck, and enclosing a space as a sunroom are among our most requested outdoor projects in Gwinnett County. We design, build, and handle the permits.

Do you pull permits for remodeling in Sugar Hill, GA?

Yes. As a licensed Georgia general contractor we handle permitting and inspections through the City of Sugar Hill or Gwinnett County, depending on your address from start to finish.

Why Sugar Hill Homeowners Choose Buford Renovations

We build lasting relationships with clients throughout Gwinnett County and the greater North Atlanta area by delivering honest work at fair prices. Our Sugar Hill customers value our responsiveness, our clean job sites, and our warranty on all completed work. Call (404) 376-5391 to book your free estimate.

Also Serving Nearby Communities

Buford Renovations also serves Buford, Gainesville, Cumming, Flowery Branch, and communities throughout Northeast Atlanta. See our main service area or call (404) 376-5391 for a free estimate.

Kitchen & Bathroom Remodeling in Gainesville, GA

Gainesville sits on the shores of Lake Lanier and anchors Hall County — from historic homes near the downtown square to newer lake-community builds off Dawsonville Highway and Thompson Bridge Road. Buford Renovations brings award-winning kitchen and bathroom remodeling to Gainesville homeowners, just 20 minutes up I-985 from our Buford headquarters.

Bathroom Remodeling in Gainesville

From master bath retreats near the Chattahoochee Country Club to hall bath updates in established neighborhoods off Enota Avenue, we build custom tile walk-in showers, install freestanding tubs and double vanities, add heated floors, and handle complete gut renovations — including all Hall County permitting and inspections. See our full bathroom remodeling services →

Kitchen Remodeling in Gainesville

We design and build kitchens with custom cabinetry, quartz and granite countertops, islands, tile backsplashes, and lighting upgrades — whether you’re refreshing a lake house or reworking the layout of a family home.

Why Gainesville Homeowners Choose Buford Renovations

Remodeling Gainesville’s Older Homes

Gainesville is not a subdivision town, and that changes how we work here. Along the Green Street historic district you have Victorian and Neo-Classical Revival houses from the late 1800s and early 1900s. Four miles south, Chicopee Village is a planned mill village laid out in 1925 and built from 1927 — 217 cottages that people have been carefully restoring for years. Out on Lake Lanier, much of the waterfront stock went up between the 1960s and the early 2000s, around Chattahoochee Country Club and the coves north of it. Newer construction near Mundy Mill rounds out the picture.

Older houses reward a contractor who has opened their walls before. Kitchens in Gainesville’s historic homes were built small and closed off, sized for an era when the kitchen was a service room rather than the center of the house. Bathrooms were often added later, carved out of a hallway or a closet. Plaster, original trim profiles, and framing that is not on modern centers all mean the surprises come during demolition, not during design. We price that reality in rather than discovering it later and handing you a change order.

On the lake side the work is different again. Those 1970s and 1980s ranch and split-level homes usually have good bones and bad layouts — a galley kitchen with a wall between it and the best view on the property. Opening that up, and rebuilding a primary bath to match, is the most common Lake Lanier project we take on.

Outdoor Living in Gainesville: Decks, Covered Patios & Sunrooms

After the kitchen and the primary bath, the next request we hear most in Gainesville is for the backyard. Homeowners want more from a basic deck: a larger patio deck for entertaining, a covered patio or covered deck that works through Georgia’s rain and summer sun, or a sunroom that turns the space into a year-round room. We design and build all three under the same written estimate and schedule as our interior work, and we pull the Hall County permits. See our deck and outdoor living services →

Kitchen & Bathroom Remodel Costs in Gainesville

Across our North Georgia service area, kitchen remodels generally run from about $15,000 for a cosmetic refresh to $75,000+ for a full custom build, with most homeowners landing between $25,000 and $45,000. Bathrooms run roughly $8,000 to $45,000+, with most mid-range renovations between $15,000 and $28,000.

Gainesville projects sit toward the upper half of those ranges more often than not, for one honest reason: older homes take more work. Bringing a 1920s bathroom up to current code, or opening a load-bearing wall in a historic kitchen, costs more than the same job in a 2005 build. We put all of it in writing before you commit — see the full breakdowns in our kitchen remodel cost guide and bathroom remodel cost guide.

Gainesville Remodeling FAQs

Do you work on historic homes in Gainesville?
Yes. We regularly work in older housing stock around Green Street and Chicopee, where original trim, plaster, and non-standard framing need a different approach than a recent build. We will tell you honestly when a period detail is worth saving and when it is not.

Who handles permits for a Gainesville remodel?
We do. Gainesville sits in Hall County rather than Gwinnett, so permitting and inspections run through a different office than our Buford-area projects — we pull the permits and schedule every inspection ourselves.

How far is Gainesville from your team?
We are based in Buford, a straight run up I-985. Gainesville and the Lake Lanier shoreline are a core part of our service area, not an outlying job we squeeze in.

Can you open up a closed-off kitchen?
Usually, yes — it is one of the most requested changes we get in Gainesville. Whether a wall can come out depends on whether it is load-bearing and what is running through it. We check that during the estimate, not after demolition.

Do you build decks, covered patios, or sunrooms in Gainesville?
Yes. Along with kitchens and primary baths, outdoor living is one of the most common requests we get in Hall County — upgrading a builder deck into a larger patio deck, adding a covered deck or covered patio, or enclosing a sunroom. We design, build, and handle the permits.

Do you offer free estimates in Gainesville, GA?
Yes — free, no obligation, with a response within one business day. Call (404) 376-5391.

Kitchen & Bathroom Remodeling in Cumming, GA

Cumming anchors fast-growing Forsyth County — consistently ranked among Georgia’s best places to live — with established neighborhoods off Buford Dam Road, newer communities along GA-400, and lake homes near Mary Alice Park. Buford Renovations brings award-winning kitchen and bathroom remodeling to Cumming homeowners, just a short drive from our Buford headquarters.

Bathroom Remodeling in Cumming

From spa-style master bathrooms in Vickery and Polo Golf & Country Club area homes to hall bath updates in established Forsyth County subdivisions, we build custom tile walk-in showers, install freestanding tubs and double vanities, add heated floors, and handle complete gut renovations — including all Forsyth County permitting and inspections. See our full bathroom remodeling services →

Kitchen Remodeling in Cumming

We design and build kitchens with custom cabinetry, quartz and granite countertops, oversized islands, tile backsplashes, and lighting upgrades — from cosmetic refreshes to full layout transformations.

Why Cumming Homeowners Choose Buford Renovations
Best of Houzz 2021–2026 · BBB Accredited · 5-star Google rated
Licensed & insured Georgia general contractor
3D design renderings and transparent written proposals
Clean job sites and on-time delivery for Forsyth County homeowners
Remodeling Cumming’s Newer Homes

Cumming does not have an old-house problem. Forsyth County has been one of Georgia’s fastest-growing counties for two decades, and most of what we work on here was built somewhere between the late 1990s and last year. In walkable communities like Vickery Village, with its Craftsman homes, deep front porches and detached garages, and in the newer development around Halcyon and the revived Cumming City Center, the houses are structurally sound and well built.

What brings Cumming homeowners to us is sameness. When a builder delivers two hundred houses off the same handful of plans, your kitchen has the same island, the same cabinet door, the same granite and the same pendant lights as four neighbors on your street. So the work here skews toward differentiation rather than repair — custom cabinetry taken to the ceiling, a range wall that becomes the actual focal point of the room, a scullery or walk-in pantry carved out of an oversized laundry, and tile that was never in the builder’s catalogue.

The other request we get constantly in Forsyth County is the primary bath. Homes from the 2000s were built with enormous corner garden tubs that most families use once a year, wrapped in cultured marble, next to a shower too small to enjoy. Reclaiming that footprint for a large tiled walk-in shower — sometimes with a freestanding tub beside it, sometimes without a tub at all — is the single most common bathroom project we do in Cumming.

Outdoor Living in Cumming: Decks, Covered Patios & Sunrooms

After the kitchen and the primary bath, the next request we hear most in Cumming is for the backyard. Newer Forsyth County homes usually come with a modest builder deck, and homeowners want more from it: a larger patio deck for entertaining, a covered patio or covered deck that works through Georgia’s rain and summer sun, or a sunroom that turns the space into a year-round room. We design and build all three under the same written estimate and schedule as our interior work, and we pull the Forsyth County permits. See our deck and outdoor living services →

Kitchen & Bathroom Remodel Costs in Cumming

A kitchen remodel in our service area typically starts near $15,000 for cosmetic work and runs past $75,000 for a full custom build, with the majority of projects landing between $25,000 and $45,000. Bathroom budgets range from roughly $8,000 to $45,000+, most often falling between $15,000 and $28,000.

Cumming projects often sit in the upper half of those ranges, though for the opposite reason to an older town: the houses are simply bigger. A 2006 kitchen in a Forsyth County subdivision has more linear feet of cabinetry and more island than a comparable kitchen closer to Atlanta. We break the numbers down scope by scope in our Cumming kitchen remodel cost guide and our bathroom remodel cost guide.

Cumming Remodeling FAQs

Do you work in Cumming’s gated and HOA communities?
Regularly. Interior remodels rarely need architectural review, but most Forsyth County HOAs do want a certificate of insurance on file and gate or gate-code arrangements for the crew before work starts. We handle that paperwork rather than leaving it to you.

Who pulls the permits for a Cumming remodel?
We do. Cumming sits in Forsyth County, so permitting and inspections run through a different office than our Gwinnett or Hall County projects. We pull the permits and schedule every inspection.

Can you replace a garden tub with a walk-in shower?
Yes, and it is the most requested bathroom change we get in Cumming. The existing tub deck usually gives us the footprint we need, which keeps the plumbing changes and the cost contained.

My kitchen looks like every other house in the neighborhood. Can you fix that?
That is most of what we do here. Cabinetry, the range wall, lighting and tile are where a builder-grade kitchen stops looking builder-grade, and none of it requires moving walls.

Do you build decks, covered patios, or sunrooms in Cumming?
Yes. Along with kitchens and primary baths, outdoor living is one of the most common requests we get in Forsyth County — upgrading a builder deck into a larger patio deck, adding a covered deck or covered patio, or enclosing a sunroom. We design, build, and handle the permits.

Do you offer free estimates in Cumming, GA?
Yes — free, no obligation, with a response within one business day. Call (404) 376-5391.

Primary baths from the 2000s–10s typically shipped with a standard tub, a framed shower, and cultured-marble counters. Coffered ceilings, judges paneling, mudroom lockers, closet systems, statement stair rails — carpentry is the fastest way to elevate newer construction, and it’s the craft our company was built on.

Between golf-course evenings and Braselton’s festival calendar, outdoor space earns its keep here. We build covered porches, decks, and outdoor kitchens engineered for Georgia summers.

Oakwood is a thriving Hall County city conveniently located along I-985 between Gainesville and Buford — known for its accessibility, growing residential base, and homeowners who value quality upgrades that make everyday living better. Buford Renovations serves Oakwood homeowners with expert kitchen and bathroom remodeling built to last.

Whether you live near Atlanta Highway (GA-13), McEver Road, or along the I-985 corridor in Hall County, our team delivers kitchen and bathroom renovations that add lasting comfort and value to your Oakwood home.

Kitchen Remodeling in Oakwood

Our Oakwood kitchen remodels focus on creating spaces that work harder and look better. We install custom and semi-custom cabinetry, quartz and granite countertops, subway and mosaic tile backsplashes, and updated lighting. Whether your Oakwood kitchen needs a cosmetic refresh or a complete structural transformation, we have the expertise to deliver it.

Bathroom Remodeling in Oakwood

We remodel bathrooms throughout Oakwood with quality materials and skilled craftsmanship. From master bathroom overhauls to hall bath updates, our work includes tile showers, new vanities, updated plumbing fixtures, and modern lighting. We handle all permitting and inspections so your project is fully compliant.

The primary bathroom is the single most requested project we get in Oakwood. Many homes here were finished with a builder-standard master bath — a large garden tub, a small shower, and cultured-marble counters — and owners are ready to turn it into a space they actually enjoy: a spacious tiled walk-in shower, a double vanity with real storage, and finishes chosen for their home rather than a builder’s catalogue. Outdoor Living: Decks, Covered Patios & Sunrooms in Oakwood

We design and build all three with the same crew and the same written estimate and schedule as our kitchen and bath work. See our deck and outdoor living services →

Kitchen & Bathroom Remodeling in Duluth, GA

Duluth blends a lively downtown — anchored by the Town Green and Parsons Alley — with established Gwinnett County neighborhoods and upscale communities like Sugarloaf Country Club. Buford Renovations brings award-winning kitchen and bathroom remodeling to Duluth homeowners, a short drive down I-85 from our Buford headquarters.

Bathroom Remodeling in Duluth

From master bath transformations in Sugarloaf and Berkeley Lake area homes to hall bath updates in classic Duluth subdivisions, we build custom tile walk-in showers, install freestanding tubs and double vanities, add heated floors, and handle complete gut renovations — including all Gwinnett County permitting and inspections. See our full bathroom remodeling services →

Kitchen Remodeling in Duluth

We design and build kitchens with custom cabinetry, quartz and granite countertops, islands, tile backsplashes, and lighting upgrades — tailored to your home and how you live in it.

Why Duluth Homeowners Choose Buford Renovations
Best of Houzz 2021–2026 · BBB Accredited · 5-star Google rated
Licensed & insured Georgia general contractor
3D design renderings and transparent written proposals
Clean job sites and on-time delivery for Gwinnett County homeowners
Two Very Different Duluths

Duluth is Gwinnett’s third-largest city, and the remodeling work here splits cleanly in two. Around the Town Green and Parsons Alley you have the older, smaller houses of the original downtown — modest square footage, compartmentalized rooms, and bathrooms that were an afterthought when the homes were built. Those projects are about winning back space: taking down the wall between a closed kitchen and a dining room nobody formally dines in, or finding the eighteen inches that turns an unusable hall bath into a real one.

Then there are the estate communities. Sugarloaf Country Club sits on roughly 1,200 acres of gated golf-course land, and St. Ives and Berkeley Hills tell a similar story. Those homes are large, they are well built, and most of them are now twenty-five to thirty years old — which means they are full of 1990s and early-2000s finishes. Heavy ornate cabinetry with a dark cherry stain. Jetted corner tubs. Cultured marble vanity tops with integrated bowls. Tumbled travertine on every surface.

There is nothing wrong with those houses structurally. They simply read as dated the moment you walk in, and that is what we are usually hired to fix — refacing or replacing cabinetry in a lighter, quieter profile, rebuilding a primary bath around a proper walk-in shower instead of a tub nobody fills, and pulling the yellowed travertine out for something that will not look dated again in five years.

Outdoor Living in Duluth: Decks, Covered Patios & Sunrooms

After the kitchen and the primary bath, the next request we hear most in Duluth is for the backyard. Homeowners want more from a basic deck: a larger patio deck for entertaining, a covered patio or covered deck that works through Georgia’s rain and summer sun, or a sunroom that turns the space into a year-round room. We design and build all three under the same written estimate and schedule as our interior work, and we pull the Gwinnett County permits. See our deck and outdoor living services →

Kitchen & Bathroom Remodel Costs in Duluth

Kitchen budgets in our service area begin around $15,000 for a refresh and reach $75,000+ for full custom work, with the middle of the market between $25,000 and $45,000. Bathrooms span roughly $8,000 to $45,000+, and most mid-range projects finish between $15,000 and $28,000.

Duluth spans both ends of that. A downtown bath refresh can sit near the bottom of the range; a full primary suite in a Sugarloaf or St. Ives home, with the cabinetry and tile those houses call for, sits at the top. We put the whole thing in writing before you commit — the full breakdowns are in our kitchen remodel cost guide and bathroom remodel cost guide.

Duluth Remodeling FAQs

Do you work inside Sugarloaf and other gated Duluth communities?
Yes. Gated communities generally require a certificate of insurance on file and advance gate clearance for the crew and deliveries. We arrange that before the first day rather than losing a morning at the gate.

Who handles permits for a Duluth remodel?
We do. Duluth is in Gwinnett County, the same jurisdiction as our Buford base, so it is the permitting office we work with most often. We pull permits and schedule all inspections.

Can you update a 1990s kitchen without gutting the whole house?
Almost always. In Duluth’s estate homes the layout is usually generous already — the dated look comes from cabinetry, counters, tile and lighting, and those can be replaced without touching walls or plumbing.

What do you do with the jetted tub?
Most Duluth clients ask us to remove it. Converting that footprint into a larger tiled shower, or a shower plus a freestanding soaking tub if the room allows, is the most common primary-bath change we make here.

Kitchen & Bathroom Remodeling in Dacula, GA

Dacula is a thriving Gwinnett County community located just east of Buford — known for its excellent schools, active neighborhoods, and the kind of suburban lifestyle that attracts long-term homeowners who invest in where they live. Buford Renovations brings that same investment mindset to every kitchen and bathroom renovation we complete here.

Whether you live near Braselton Highway, Auburn Road, or along the GA-316 corridor, our team delivers kitchen and bathroom renovations that add lasting comfort and value to your Dacula home.

Kitchen Remodeling in Dacula

Our Dacula kitchen remodels focus on creating spaces that work harder and look better. We install custom and semi-custom cabinetry, quartz and granite countertops, subway and mosaic tile backsplashes, and updated lighting. Whether your Dacula kitchen needs a cosmetic refresh or a complete structural transformation, we have the expertise to deliver it.

Bathroom Remodeling in Dacula

We remodel bathrooms throughout Dacula with quality materials and skilled craftsmanship. From master bathroom overhauls to hall bath updates, our work includes tile showers, new vanities, updated plumbing fixtures, and modern lighting. We handle all permitting and inspections so your project is fully compliant.

The primary bathroom is the single most requested project we get in Dacula. Many homes here were finished with a builder-standard master bath — a large garden tub, a small shower, and cultured-marble counters — and owners are ready to turn it into a space they actually enjoy: a spacious tiled walk-in shower, a double vanity with real storage, and finishes chosen for their home rather than a builder’s catalogue. For typical budgets, see our 2026 bathroom remodel cost guide.

Outdoor Living: Decks, Covered Patios & Sunrooms in Dacula

Not every Dacula project happens indoors. Many homeowners ask us to upgrade a basic builder deck into a larger patio deck, add a covered patio or covered deck for shade and rain, or enclose the space as a sunroom for year-round use. We design and build all three with the same crew and the same written estimate and schedule as our kitchen and bath work. See our deck and outdoor living services →

We Know Dacula’s Homes

Buford Renovations has been working in Dacula and across Gwinnett County for more than 20 years — Dacula is just east of our Buford shop. The homes that most often come to us for a renovation are 5 to 10 years old — well built, but finished with the builder-standard cabinets, counters, and tile that owners are ready to make their own. Kitchens and primary bathrooms lead the list, followed by outdoor living upgrades: patio decks, covered decks, and sunrooms.

Dacula Remodeling FAQs
How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Dacula?

Every project gets a fixed written estimate after a free in-home consultation — the shower, tile, and any plumbing changes drive cost more than square footage. For typical ranges in our service area, see our 2026 bathroom remodel cost guide, or call (404) 376-5391.

Do you build decks, covered patios, and sunrooms in Dacula?

Yes. Upgrading a basic deck into a larger patio deck, adding a covered patio or covered deck, and enclosing a space as a sunroom are among our most requested outdoor projects in Gwinnett County. We design, build, and handle the permits.

Do you pull permits for remodeling in Dacula, GA?

Yes. As a licensed Georgia general contractor we handle permitting and inspections through Gwinnett County (or the City of Dacula where applicable) from start to finish.

Why Dacula Homeowners Choose Buford Renovations

We build lasting relationships with clients throughout Gwinnett County and the greater North Atlanta area by delivering honest work at fair prices. Our Dacula customers value our responsiveness, our clean job sites, and our warranty on all completed work. Call (404) 376-5391 to book your free estimate.

Also Serving Nearby Communities

Buford Renovations also serves Buford, Auburn, Lawrenceville, Hoschton, and communities throughout Gwinnett County. See our main service area or call (404) 376-5391 for a free estimate.

Kitchen & Bathroom Remodeling in Dawsonville, GA

Dawsonville is the heart of Dawson County and one of North Georgia’s most scenic communities — known for its mountain backdrop, GA-400 access, and a strong base of homeowners who invest in comfortable, well-maintained properties. Buford Renovations serves Dawsonville homeowners with expert kitchen and bathroom remodeling that fits the quality of life this area is known for.

Whether you live near GA-400, Highway 9 (Dawsonville Highway), or the neighborhoods throughout Dawson County, our team delivers kitchen and bathroom renovations that add lasting comfort and value to your Dawsonville home.

Kitchen Remodeling in Dawsonville

Our Dawsonville kitchen remodels focus on creating spaces that work harder and look better. We install custom and semi-custom cabinetry, quartz and granite countertops, subway and mosaic tile backsplashes, and updated lighting. Whether your Dawsonville kitchen needs a cosmetic refresh or a complete structural transformation, we have the expertise to deliver it.

Bathroom Remodeling in Dawsonville

We remodel bathrooms throughout Dawsonville with quality materials and skilled craftsmanship. From master bathroom overhauls to hall bath updates, our work includes tile showers, new vanities, updated plumbing fixtures, and modern lighting. We handle all permitting and inspections so your project is fully compliant.

The primary bathroom is the single most requested project we get in Dawsonville. Many homes here were finished with a builder-standard master bath — a large garden tub, a small shower, and cultured-marble counters — and owners are ready to turn it into a space they actually enjoy: a spacious tiled walk-in shower, a double vanity with real storage, and finishes chosen for their home rather than a builder’s catalogue. For typical budgets, see our 2026 bathroom remodel cost guide.

Outdoor Living: Decks, Covered Patios & Sunrooms in Dawsonville

Not every Dawsonville project happens indoors. Many homeowners ask us to upgrade a basic builder deck into a larger patio deck, add a covered patio or covered deck for shade and rain, or enclose the space as a sunroom for year-round use. We design and build all three with the same crew and the same written estimate and schedule as our kitchen and bath work. See our deck and outdoor living services →

We Know Dawsonville’s Homes

Buford Renovations has been remodeling homes across North Georgia and metro Atlanta for more than 20 years, including Dawsonville and the rest of Dawson County. The homes that most often come to us for a renovation are 5 to 10 years old — well built, but finished with the builder-standard cabinets, counters, and tile that owners are ready to make their own. Kitchens and primary bathrooms lead the list, followed by outdoor living upgrades: patio decks, covered decks, and sunrooms. Every project is scheduled with realistic drive-time planning from our Buford shop, so the crew arrives when we say it will.

Dawsonville Remodeling FAQs
How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Dawsonville?

Every project gets a fixed written estimate after a free in-home consultation — the shower, tile, and any plumbing changes drive cost more than square footage. For typical ranges in our service area, see our 2026 bathroom remodel cost guide, or call (404) 376-5391.

Do you build decks, covered patios, and sunrooms in Dawsonville?

Yes. Upgrading a basic deck into a larger patio deck, adding a covered patio or covered deck, and enclosing a space as a sunroom are among our most requested outdoor projects in Dawson County. We design, build, and handle the permits.

Do you pull permits for remodeling in Dawsonville, GA?

Yes. As a licensed Georgia general contractor we handle permitting and inspections through Dawson County (or the City of Dawsonville where applicable) from start to finish.

Why Dawsonville Homeowners Choose Buford Renovations

We build lasting relationships with clients throughout Dawson County and the greater North Atlanta area by delivering honest work at fair prices. Our Dawsonville customers value our responsiveness, our clean job sites, and our warranty on all completed work. Call (404) 376-5391 to book your free estimate.

Buford Renovations also serves Cumming, Gainesville, Ball Ground, Dahlonega, and communities throughout North Georgia. See our main service area or call (404) 376-5391 for a free estimate.

Kitchen Remodeling in Buford, GA
Award-Winning Kitchen Remodeling for Buford & North Georgia

The kitchen is where your home earns its keep — and where dated layouts cost you every single day. Buford Renovations is a design-build kitchen remodeler with 20+ years of construction experience, a 5.0 Google rating, BBB accreditation (A+), and Best of Houzz honors every year from 2021 through 2026. From cabinet refacing to full structural transformations, we design it with you and build it with our own crews — one contract, one written schedule, one accountable team.

Our Kitchen Remodeling Services
Custom Cabinetry

The craft we were founded on. Cabinets built to your kitchen’s exact dimensions — to the ceiling, around corners builders gave up on, with soft-close hardware and the pull-outs, dividers, and pantry systems you’ll actually use. When semi-custom fits the budget better, we’ll tell you honestly and spec the best of it.

Full Kitchen Remodels

Layout, cabinets, counters, backsplash, flooring, lighting, and appliance integration — the complete transformation, managed end to end so the finishes align and the schedule holds.

Open-Concept Conversions

The most requested change in North Georgia’s 1990s–2000s homes: take down the wall, add the island, and connect the kitchen to the life of the house. We handle the structural engineering, permits, and beam work that make it safe and seamless.

Countertops & Backsplash

Quartz, granite, and butcher block fabricated and installed with the tile work our reviews rave about — full-height backsplashes, waterfall edges, and islands built for gathering.

Kitchen Islands & Lighting

Working islands with seating, storage, and power — paired with layered lighting (ambient, task, statement) that changes how the whole room feels at 7am and 7pm alike.

What Does a Kitchen Remodel Cost in Buford?

Honest ranges from our 2026 projects:

Refresh (paint or reface cabinets, new counters, backsplash, lighting): $10,000 – $20,000
Mid-range remodel (new semi-custom cabinets, quartz, appliances, flooring): $25,000 – $45,000
Full custom remodel (layout changes, custom cabinetry, island, premium finishes): $50,000 – $80,000
Luxury / structural (wall removals, additions, top-tier materials): $75,000 – $120,000

Cabinetry drives 30–40% of most kitchen budgets — it’s the first decision we design around. For market-specific numbers, see our cost guides for Buford and Gainesville, or call for a free fixed written estimate.

Our Process

A free in-home consultation starts it — we measure, listen, and talk honestly about scope and budget. Then design and selections: layout, cabinetry, counters, and lighting chosen with you before anything is ordered. You approve a fixed written estimate and a written schedule, our crew builds with a contained work zone and daily cleanup, and we finish with a walkthrough and punch list. The price is the price.

Why Buford Homeowners Choose Us

Licensed and insured. BBB accredited with an A+ rating. A 5.0 rating across our Google reviews and Best of Houzz five years running — earned one kitchen at a time across Buford, Sugar Hill, Suwanee, and the whole North Georgia map. Browse our portfolio to see the cabinetry and tile work for yourself.

Serving Buford & All of North Georgia

From our Buford Highway headquarters we serve 20+ communities, including Sugar Hill, Suwanee, Gainesville, and Cumming — see all our service areas. Planning the bath too? Our bathroom remodeling team works the same way.

Kitchen Remodeling FAQs
How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Buford?

Honest 2026 ranges: refreshes run $10,000–$20,000, mid-range remodels $25,000–$45,000, full custom projects $50,000–$80,000, and luxury or structural remodels $75,000–$120,000. Cabinetry typically drives 30–40% of the budget. You’ll get a fixed written estimate after a free in-home consultation.

How long does a kitchen remodel take?

Most full kitchen remodels run 4–8 weeks once materials are on hand — refreshes are faster, structural projects longer. You get a written schedule before work begins, and daily cleanup is non-negotiable.

Can you build custom cabinets, or do you only install?

Custom cabinetry is the craft our company was founded on. We design and build cabinets to your kitchen’s exact dimensions — to the ceiling, around odd corners, with the storage you actually need — and we also work with quality semi-custom lines when the budget calls for it.

Do you handle permits for kitchen remodels?

Yes — as your licensed general contractor we pull and manage permits through the City of Buford, Gwinnett County, or whichever authority your address requires, including structural permits for wall removals, and all inspections.

Bathroom Remodeling in Buford, GA
Award-Winning Bathroom Remodeling for Buford & North Georgia

Your bathroom is the hardest-working room in the house — and the one where dated design shows first. Buford Renovations is a design-build bathroom remodeler with 20+ years of construction experience, a 5.0 Google rating, BBB accreditation (A+), and Best of Houzz honors every year from 2021 through 2026. From a one-week refresh to a full primary-suite build, we design it with you and build it with our own crews — one contract, one written schedule, one accountable team.

Our Bathroom Remodeling Services
Walk-In Shower Conversions

Our most requested project: retire the unused tub, build a custom tile walk-in shower with frameless glass, add a bench and niche, and finish with fixtures that feel like a daily upgrade. Conversions transform how a bathroom lives without touching the footprint. See our walk-in shower conversion cost guide for real 2026 pricing.

Full Bathroom Remodels

New tile, vanity, counters, lighting, fixtures, and flooring — the complete reset. We handle plumbing and electrical in-house coordination, so the schedule holds and the finishes align.

Primary Suite Bathrooms

Freestanding tubs, double vanities, heated floors, dedicated water closets — where space allows, we’ve expanded footprints into neighboring closets or bedrooms to create the retreat the house deserved all along.

Hall & Guest Bathrooms

Compact baths reward smart design: wall-hung storage, right-sized vanities, tile that makes the room feel larger. High impact, contained timeline, guest-ready results.

Accessibility & Aging-in-Place

Curbless showers, grab bars engineered into the framing (not bolted on as an afterthought), comfort-height fixtures, and slip-resistant tile — beautiful bathrooms that work for every stage of life.

What Does a Bathroom Remodel Cost in Buford?

Honest ranges from our 2026 projects across North Georgia:

Refresh (vanity, fixtures, paint, lighting): $3,500 – $8,500
Mid-range remodel (tile, tub or shower replacement, vanity, flooring): $8,500 – $18,000
Full custom remodel (layout changes, custom tile walk-in shower): $15,000 – $28,000
Luxury / primary-suite build: $30,000 – $55,000

Scope drives the number — not square footage. For market-specific breakdowns, see our cost guides for Buford, Suwanee, and Sugar Hill, or call for a free fixed written estimate.

Our Process

It starts with a free in-home consultation — we measure, listen, and talk honestly about scope and budget. Then design and selections: layout, tile, vanity, glass, and fixtures chosen with you before anything is ordered. You approve a fixed written estimate and a written schedule, our crew builds with daily cleanup and a contained work zone, and we finish with a walkthrough and punch list. No drifting numbers, no disappearing contractor.

Licensed and insured. BBB accredited with an A+ rating. A 5.0 rating across our Google reviews and Best of Houzz five years running. But the reason neighbors refer us is simpler: we show up when we said we would, the price is the price, and the tile lines are straight. Browse our portfolio to see the finish level for yourself.

How long does a bathroom remodel take?

Most full bathroom remodels run 2–4 weeks once materials arrive. Walk-in shower conversions are often faster; primary-suite expansions run longer. Every project starts with a written schedule, and we keep you updated daily.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom remodel in Buford?

If plumbing, electrical, or structural work is involved — yes. As your licensed general contractor we pull and manage permits through the City of Buford, Gwinnett County, Hall County, or whichever authority your address requires, inspections included.

Tub-to-shower conversions with custom tile and frameless glass typically run $8,000–$15,000 installed depending on size and finishes — the single most requested bathroom upgrade across our service area. You’ll get an exact fixed price after a free in-home consultation.

Can I stay in my home during the remodel?

Almost all our clients do. We contain the work zone, protect floors and adjacent rooms, and leave the site clean every day — if your home has a second bath, daily life continues around us.

Kitchen & Bathroom Remodeling Services in Buford, GA

These are our services with the specifications of what we do

Kitchen remodeling

A kitchen is more than just a stunning backsplash and gorgeous cabinets. We will plan and build kitchens that you can't wait to cook and entertain in.

Bathroom remodeling

We all want a bathroom that would be a reflection of our personal style and be able to deliver the comfort we need at the same time.

Custom carpentry

We are dedicated to producing the highest quality home that both you and I will be proud of for years to come. If Custom Carpentry sounds like the right choice for you and your project, please contact us

Design of spaces

If you are in the middle of redesigning your home or have the budget to make some structural changes, we suggest you knock down a few walls and open up areas. An ideal open floor plan should be between the living room, dining and kitchen.

Decoration of spaces

Design defines the art of planning, furnishing and renovating indoor spaces, expressing a style, representing a message and enhancing the experience of people facilitating movement and interaction.

General construction

It is an overarching term describing various forms of construction projects such as design, build, and remodel. Each facet of general construction generally involves a general contractor who will oversee every part of the process.

Outdoor areas

Being outdoors with access to fresh air is not just good for our state of mind. Leveraging social, collaborative and personal outdoor spaces provides even greater choice for safer work environments.

Get In Touch

Give us a call today for more information on how we can start working on the project of your dreams.
